# oneprovider_server (Resource)

OneProvider server resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a dedicated server
# Note: oneprovider_server is intended to manage an *existing* server. Import it first.
resource "oneprovider_server" "example" {
  # Update hostname
  hostname = "myserver.example.com"
}

# Import existing server:
# terraform import oneprovider_server.example 12345
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) Server hostname

### Read-Only

- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle
- `id` (String) Server ID
- `ip_addr` (String) Server IP address
- `location` (String) Server location
- `recurring_amount` (String) Recurring amount
- `status` (String) Server status
- `username` (String) Server username
